answer: Because your ex is still on the title, they need to sign too, the same as any co-owner, unless your divorce decree awards the car to you. In that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. For the name mismatch, bring the document that shows your name change, such as the divorce decree or a court order. You'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
